front.title: Terminology and Architectural Patterns for Detached Evidence Delivery

abstract.t: This document describes a detached evidence handoff between independently administered organizations. It distinguishes artifact delivery, content integrity, source authentication, registration, reconciliation, and recipient decisions. It describes how a recipient can return a signed comparison against stated benchmarks, with a commitment to the figures it compared, without exporting its source ledger. Worked examples illustrate both a disclosed reconciliation and a comparison attestation. The document defines terminology and an architectural model; it specifies no wire protocol.
